name: vibe-du-sud
description: Site statique de Vibe du Sud (vibe-du-sud.fr) : seul le dossier public/ est mis en ligne.

scripts.dev: npm run build && concurrently -k -i --default-input-target serveur -n css,js,serveur -c magenta,yellow,cyan "npm:watch:css" "npm:watch:js" "npm:serve"
scripts.build: npm run build:css && npm run build:js && npm run build:version
scripts.build:version: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),h=f=>require('crypto').createHash('md5').update(fs.readFileSync('public/assets/'+f)).digest('hex').slice(0,8),v={css:h('css/style.min.css'),js:h('js/main.min.js')};let n=0;for(const f of fs.readdirSync('public',{recursive:true}))if(f.endsWith('.html')){const p='public/'+f,t=fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8'),r=t.replace(/(style\.min\.css|main\.min\.js)\?v=\w+/g,(m,a)=>a+'?v='+(a.endsWith('css')?v.css:v.js));if(r!==t){fs.writeFileSync(p,r);n++}}console.log('Version des fichiers : css '+v.css+', js '+v.js+' ('+n+' pages mises a jour)')"
scripts.images: npm run images:portrait && npm run images:paysage
scripts.images:portrait: sharp -i "src/img-originales/portrait/*" -o "public/assets/img/{name}-896w.webp" -f webp -q 80 resize 896 --withoutEnlargement && sharp -i "src/img-originales/portrait/*" -o "public/assets/img/{name}-480w.webp" -f webp -q 80 resize 480
scripts.images:paysage: sharp -i "src/img-originales/paysage/*" -o "public/assets/img/{name}-1376w.webp" -f webp -q 80 resize 1376 --withoutEnlargement && sharp -i "src/img-originales/paysage/*" -o "public/assets/img/{name}-960w.webp" -f webp -q 80 resize 960 && sharp -i "src/img-originales/paysage/*" -o "public/assets/img/{name}-480w.webp" -f webp -q 80 resize 480
